chunks: God vindicates the truth by His commands, however the sinners may dislike it.

key_terms.الْمُجْرِمُونَ: the sinners / those who commit crimes
key_terms.يُحِقُّ: to make true / to vindicate / to establish as real

ai.seo_question: How does God establish the truth despite the disbelievers' dislike?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine truth (al-Haqq) prevailing over falsehood (al-Batil), reflecting the cosmic order where God's promises are absolute. It serves as a comfort to the faithful, particularly in the context of the Imams' struggle against oppressors, assuring that despite the temporary resistance of the 'mujrimun' (sinners), the ultimate victory belongs to God's word.
